facts.value: When selecting a partner university, please note the general language requirements mentioned here as well as the specific language requirements of the respective partner university in the different country sections. Please also refer to the general notes on the course offerings at the host university.
The information regarding the TOEFL test refers to the internet-based test. Please note that a 'MyBest Scores' result will not be accepted.
If you do not speak the language of the host country, we recommend that you acquire basic knowledge of the respective language where possible. However, this is not a requirement for admission!
If multiple language requirements are listed (e.g., B2/TOEFL/IELTS), these should be understood as alternatives, meaning you only need to submit proof of one language certificate.
